$comment: Projects and education. Dates are 'YYYY-MM'; end: null means ongoing. experienceId links a project to an entry in experience.json (null = independent, e.g. BitSpace). relatedProjectIds links projects to each other. lane: where it appears on the timeline ('projects' = shown above its work box on hover, 'venture' = its own bar under the studies).

projects.title: Cloud segmentation
projects.summary: A computer-vision model that segments different cloud types in multispectral Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery.

projects.title: Signal Processing UI
projects.summary: My first project with the team: a web interface that runs fellow researchers’ processing scripts, making shared code easy to use.

projects.title: Rotatory Antenna System
projects.summary: A rotating antenna system that tracks satellites and captures their signals, built end to end: 3D-modelled hardware, part selection and firmware, C code that reads TLE data and propagates orbits with SGP4, and the web interface that controls it all.

projects.title: USRP X440 Operating Tool
projects.summary: Scripts and interfaces that make Ettus’ direct-sampling USRP X440 SDR easy for researchers to use: they enter the signal parameters they want to record, and the tool works out everything the USRP needs.

projects.title: BSProof
projects.summary: An app that grades supplements on scientific evidence, cutting through the noise and confusion of buying them.
